metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: Trend-following contract: tight SL (1.5×ATR) maximizes RR ratio (1:1.67). Wider TP (2.5×ATR) lets trend runners capture extended moves. Lower hit rate compensated by higher reward per win. Designed for Brain_Trend assigned to barrier_12bar/m15_swing/m30_swing.
metadata.design_notes: Asymmetric label for trend-following models. SL=1.5×ATR prevents noise stop-outs while TP=2.5×ATR captures directional persistence. Contract pairs with label-reversion-1.0.0 in the dual-track training scheme.
